Piers Morgan announces new book about the ‘war on free speech’

Morgan's publishers describe the divisive host's latest tome as "a rallying cry for a united future"
   
1/41
Katie Rosseinsky @katierosseinsky
16 July 2020 COMMENTS
The Weekender The Weekender

...

Read our privacy notice .
Piers Morgan has announced his latest project: a book about the so-called “outraged woke brigade” and “war on free speech.”
The new book from the Good Morning Britain host, 55, is titled Wake Up: Why The ‘Liberal’ War On Free Speech Is Even More Dangerous Than Covid-19.
It is set for release on October 15 and will also be available as an audio book read by Morgan himself.
After teasing a “big announcement” on Twitter on Thursday morning, Morgan shared the news at midday, revealing he was “delighted” about the impending release.
According to a synopsis, Morgan was moved to write the book as he “watched as the culture wars raged and deep divisions at the heart of our society were exposed” during the coronavirus pandemic.
“Wake Up is Piers’ rallying cry for a united future,” the description continues. “He makes the case that a new type of ‘liberalism’ has emerged that is not only fundamentally illiberal, but also

...

“Above all, it’s a powerful account of how the world has finally started to wake up, and why it mustn’t go back to sleep again.”

Piers Morgan to join News Corp and FOX News Media in global deal
* New global TV show will air on weeknights in the UK, USA and Australia;
* Morgan will publish two weekly columns online for the New York Post and The Sun;
* HarperCollins to publish follow up to Sunday Times No1 bestseller, Wake Up.
Piers Morgan will join News Corp and FOX News Media in a global deal, launching a new TV show in early 2022. Morgan will also join The Sun and the New York Post as a columnist.
Following the phenomenal success of his Sunday Times No.1 bestseller, Wake Up, HarperCollins UK has signed world rights for Piers Morgan’s new title and will publish in hardback, audio and digital formats.
Piers will also present a series of True Crime documentaries.
Piers Morgan said: “I’m thrilled to be returning to News Corp.

...

Piers Morgan’s new show will air on talkTV in the UK, FOX Nation for US audiences, and on Sky News Australia. The show will be produced and filmed at News UK’s studios in London Bridge.

...

HarperCollins will publish the follow up to Sunday Times No1 bestselling book, Wake Up.
Charlie Redmayne, CEO of HarperCollins UK, said: “There is simply no one better than Piers Morgan at getting people talking and thinking about the key issues affecting society today. We are excited to be working with Piers on his eagerly awaited follow up book.”
